LanguageData.CC_Settings_MedicalTriage: Best bed first, and room made for the worse off (Move the Patient)
LanguageData.CC_Settings_MedicalTriage_Tip: With Move the Patient: the mod keeps its High and Critical beds free for worse cases and gives a surgery bed only to someone waiting for an operation, so a hurt colonist often lies in a lesser bed while the best one stands empty. With this on, a patient going to a medical bed takes the best free one they may use: the one you ranked highest with the mod's priority, then the one the game treats best in (the bed's tending and immunity, the room's cleanliness), then the nearest. A surgery bed counts for anyone while nobody waiting for an operation could use it. When someone worse off (the mod's own severity: Critical, High, Normal, Low) or someone waiting for an operation needs a better bed than any free one, the nearest colonist who does doctoring carries the lighter case to the best other free medical bed with the mod's "Transfer to bed", and the one worse off is brought in. Never someone being operated on or tended, in a mental state or in labour, never into a bed of the other kind, never when no other medical bed is free, and nobody twice within four hours. Off with the mod set to the nearest bed. Needs the deeper game hooks.
